title: Rahe Sameep Badeyn
desc: Javed Akhtar says one imbibes the culture he/she blossoms in, if one is born in a good environment, he/she ought to imbibe the goodness but, if the environment is faulty, it directly reflects on him/her.

title: Jo Jako Gun
desc: Javed Akhtar talks about how humans are evolving & so are their inclinations. Sweetness can be bittered & a bitter person can turn sweet, it's a matter of time, perspective & what they receive from the world.

title: Ati Agaadh Ati
desc: Javed Akhtar explains how comparison only breeds jealousy. He says everyone should consider a home where ever they feel the most peaceful, be it places, emotions, people etc.
